Resolves #21324

The color field's list opens again, the chip field's inline label floats above its chips, and the form app's Save stores its values. `ComboBox#beforeSetListConfig()` and `AmChart#beforeSetChartConfig()` now hand `parseItemConfigs()` their one config object as one item, the path it took before `6c8b81c848` began reading a plain object as a keyed items map. `Chip#afterSetValue()` toggles `neo-has-content` from `hasContent()`, and `onSaveButtonClick()` declares `me`.

Evidence: L3 (unit specs red on base and green at head; a scripted browser run on the dev server before and after) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3, AC-4, AC-6). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/core/ParseItemConfigs.spec.mjs` › "a color field hands its own formatter and field to its list", red on base. Outside-CI: the trigger of `examples/form/field/color` opens 6 coloured items with no console error; on base it opens 0 and throws `TypeError: me.colorFormatter is not a function`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `ParseItemConfigs.spec.mjs` › "resolves every item of a keyed items map", green on base and at head. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/form/field/Chip.spec.mjs` › "a value in chips counts as content while the input stays empty, so an inline label floats", red on base. Outside-CI: the chip example's field carries `neo-has-content` at rest; on base it does not. |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: Save in `apps/form` stores `{"firstname":null,"lastname":null,"status":"Active","page3":{"field1":"foo",…` under `neo-form` with no error; on base it throws `me is not defined` and stores nothing. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `ParseItemConfigs.spec.mjs` › "an amCharts wrapper resolves a heat rule nested in its chartConfig", red on base. |
| AC-6 | Outside-CI: the frames under Test Evidence. The form app's Save changes nothing on screen, so AC-4's receipt stands in for its frame. |

## Deltas from ticket

- AC-6's form-app frame is dropped: the page looks the same before and after Save (identical captures). That Save gives a visitor no feedback is input for the Form App renewal under #21140.

Red on base: with only the three source fixes reverted, the three #21324 specs fail and the other 16 in both files pass.

- [x] On `dev`, `apps/covid`'s world map colours its countries through the heat rule, whose `maxValue` is now a number. The same read with `AmChart.mjs` from `0128668721`: the unresolved string `'@config:heatRulesMaxValue'` and 0 polygons.
